pages.title: Evolutionarily Stable Strategy
pages.text: A mix of ways to behave that, once common, nothing else can invade: Maynard Smith's answer to why animals mostly fight by display. Recorded at the Strategy Table. The Bioreactor grows Tardigrade Cultures cheaply with one.
